body_ar: إن الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينه ، ونعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا ومن سيئات أعمالنا من يهده الله فلا مضل ومن يضلل فلا هادي له ، وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله صلى الله عليه وعلى آله وأصحابه وسلم تسليما كثيرا (يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا) (يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آَمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا).
body_en:
Praise belongs to God; we praise Him and we seek His help, and we seek refuge with God from the evils of our own souls and from the ill consequences of our deeds. Whomever God guides, none can lead astray; and whomever He leads astray, there is no guide for him. And I bear witness that there is no god but God alone, having no partner; and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger — God bless him, and his family and his Companions, and grant them abundant peace.

{O people, be conscious of your Lord, who created you from a single soul and created from it its mate, and spread abroad from the two of them many men and women. And be conscious of God, through whom you ask of one another, and of the ties of kinship. Indeed God is ever watchful over you} (Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:1). {O you who believe, be conscious of God and speak words that are apt. He will set right your deeds for you and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys God and His Messenger has attained a mighty attainment} (Sūrat al-Aḥzāb 33:70–71).

flags.note: POSSIBLE LACUNA IN QUOTED SCRIPTURE — STYLE GUIDE §11. The khuṭbat al-ḥājah conventionally carries three verses: Āl ʿImrān 3:102, al-Nisāʾ 4:1, and al-Aḥzāb 33:70-71. This record has only the second and third. The first may have been dropped in transcription, or the Sheikh may simply not have recited it. The house rule is explicit that a lacuna in quoted scripture is left visible and never restored from memory, and nothing has been supplied. A reviewer with the .docx can confirm.

translator_notes: The date carried here is the CMS record date. Qur'anic and hadith renderings in this file are interpretive translations of meaning, offered to carry the Sheikh's argument in English. They are not a substitute for the Arabic.
The record is typed khutbah rather than transcript because the published text is the opening of a sermon, not of a lesson.

The two Qur'anic quotations are given in the source in round brackets, fully vowelled, and without references; the references have been supplied per house style and the quotations set in the curly braces of house style.
The khuṭbat al-ḥājah is itself a recited formula, so the Arabic in body_ar is the operative text.
